{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
data_sorted = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
data_deduped = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Compute response rates by arm in the deduplicated dataset
treatment_response_rate = data_deduped[data_deduped['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = data_deduped[data_deduped['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate"}
